This hour I found 10 FEBio jobs that had failed a second time without anyone noticing, put them back in the queue, and left the tuning as it was. **Inventory** - **CPU:** the 32-core quota is the limit, with 31.3 cores in use and 61 % of periods throttled. The host load is 59 of 256 cores. - **Memory:** 125.6 of 137.4 GB in the cgroup, but only 54.5 GB is program memory; the other 73.7 GB is file cache, mostly freeable. No out-of-memory kills. - **Disk:** /raid has 2.6 TB free. - **GPUs:** GPUs 0–4 and 6 are used by other users. GPU 5 runs 4 of my jobs at 16–24 % utilisation. - **FEBio queue (old repo):** - 11 running: 7 on CPU, 4 on GPU 5 (p092–p095). - 44 waiting after the re-queue; the oldest is from 04:06. - Done 2356, failed 2. - In the last 3 h, 35 runs finished, 9 of them normally. 21 of the 35 were the two GPU failure bursts. - **New-repo task queue:** empty. The 5 failed tasks are old (10-28). - **Health:** all tmux services are up, and all 11 running logs were written in the last 44 s. **Problem fixed** - **What happened:** last run's fix re-queued 11 jobs that failed because of a wrong file path in the GPU solver config. 10 of them failed again between 08:38 and 08:52, about 2 s each. The scheduler logged them as "exit=0", so they looked like successes. - **Cause:** they are split cases. `h31_split_run.py` skips the first stage of the run when the old `case.log` ends in ERROR, then exits 1. - **Fix:** for p068 p074 p075 p076 p077 p078 p079 p081 p086 p088, I moved the bad `case.log`, `case.dmp` and `case.xplt` into `

_gpu5/_bad_cnf_20261103/` (nothing deleted). Then I copied their job files back into the queue. With no old log, the next run starts from the beginning and still goes through the h24 preflight. - **Not checked yet:** none of the 10 has started, because the CPU limit allows no new launches right now. Next hour I will check that they start from the beginning and get past the first stage. **No change** - `CPU_OVERCOMMIT` stays at 1.375. CPU use is 31.3/32 cores and program memory 54.5 GB, under my 100 GB limit. - I did not restart the scheduler, because CPU split runs are running. **Requests (need a person)** - **Scheduler exit code:** `h19_scheduler.py` logs "exit=0" and moves the job to done/ even when the run failed. It should log the real exit code and send failed runs to failed/. That is a code change, not a setting, so it is outside what I may edit. - **Retry:** `h31` never retries a run that failed at step 0 because of a setup problem rather than the model. The code owner needs to decide whether it should. - **Science:** physrotFr3_p084 ended in ERROR at t = 3.04 with 4822 negative-Jacobian lines. I did not re-queue it. The report is `work/agents/foreman/report_20261103_0935.md`; `status.json` and `foreman_actions.log` are updated.
